messages:
aj: getting pages 1 - apiserver 5xx spike across eu-west1, controller-manager crashloops, and Dedicated GPU autoscaler firing repeatedly.

sre-bot: [ALERT] apiserver 5xx surge (eu-west1) 1 - 3275019999 - severity: high

mia: checked the apiserver pods - many connections in CLOSE_WAIT and apiserver's `http2` waiter backlog growing. probe latencies for controller-manager jump to 8s before it OOMs its workqueue.

leo: any recent control plane changes? I recall a kube-apiserver arg tweak in the rolling canary last night (`--max-requests-inflight=200`) and a proxy multiplex switch in the sidecar.

kate: yes we merged the sidecar multiplexer PR (net/mux-stream) at 22:40 last night. Canary looked fine but traffic pattern changed after a batch jobs window. maybe long-lived streams aren't torn down correctly.

natalie: cost note: autoscaler added +16 GPUs in eu-west1 in past 40m. finance alert triggered. if this is a leak we'll keep paying for nodes that aren't helping.

aj: attaching quick lsof/ss snapshot from proxy on node-7: 
```
root@node-7:~# ps aux | grep proxy
proxy 2345  35.2  4.0 /usr/local/bin/proxy --mux
root@node-7:~# lsof -p 2345 | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l
48210
root@node-7:~# ss -tan state close-wait | wc -l
12543
```
several thousand CLOSE_WAITs towards kubelets and gpu-attach endpoints.

mia: I restarted proxy on node-7 (graceful) and see apiserver 5xx drop for that AZ. partial mitigation helps.

deploy-bot: infra: restarted proxy daemonset on nodes [node-6,node-7] - 3275020035

leo: good signal - suggests the sidecar mux holds backend sockets after client disconnects. Need repro in staging. I'll run a reproducer that spawns many long-lived unary+stream requests and kills client side fast.

kate: also suspect the kube-apiserver arg change reduced concurrency headroom; combined with fd exhaustion in proxies it amplified latencies. revert?

aj: if we revert `--max-requests-inflight` we risk letting crazy clients slam the apiserver. Alternative: throttle client streams earlier in proxy and add aggressive half-close handling.

natalie: immediate ops: 1) pause autoscaler scale-ups for eu-west1 (set max-provision=0) 2) keep rolling restart of proxy daemonset in 20-node batches until fd counts normal 3) mute nonessential batch traffic to reduce stream churn. Finance will approve short hold.

mia: patched cluster-autoscaler configmap to prevent further scale-ups and muted nightly batch jobs to staging traffic: `kubectl scale job nightly-embeddings -n ml --replicas=0` (temporary).

leo: reproducer in staging shows mux.go leaking sessions when a stream is reset mid-handshake. tiny code excerpt from staging logs: 
```
E mux: session close failed: write: broken pipe
W mux: orphaned backend session id=0x3b7 leaked
```

kate: filing hotfix in networking: incrementally close backend connections on stream reset and add timeout to idle backend sessions. also add FD gauge to proxy exporter.

aj: will push a small runtime patch to staging (mux idle-timeout=30s) and run soak. if green, hotfix to prod can follow.

sre-bot: [INFO] cost-alert: eu-west1 GPU spend +16% vs baseline - 3275020055

natalie: thanks. I'll keep the cost channel updated and raise a short-lived spend waiver for the autoscaler hold period.

mia: action items captured: aj - continue rolling restarts and capture tcpdumps; leo - repro + submit PR with tests; kate - patch mux to close backends on reset + add metrics; natalie - monitor spend and coordinate finance; I'll draft an incident note.

leo: one more thought - add a small kube-proxy/iptables backstop to limit ESTABLISHED connections per process on proxies to avoid total fd exhaustion while we patch.

kate: agreed. will open a follow-up config PR for conntrack/iptables hardening.

mia: if restarts keep apiserver healthy we'll roll the hotfix tonight. converting thread to postmortem draft if we revert. :thumbsup:

aj: tcpdump and lsof outputs uploaded to infra logs: https://infra/logs/3275020060 - posting there. will update after staging soak (30m).
